query.description: One PromQL expression that gives an instant vector or a scalar, such as rate(http_requests_total[5m]).

start.description: Start of the range: ISO 8601 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:00:00Z) or relative to now (-1h, now-30m, now). Default: one hour before end.

end.description: End of the range: ISO 8601 with an offset (2026-11-11T09:00:00Z) or relative to now (-1h, now-30m, now). Default: now.

step.description: Time between points: a duration (30s, 5m, 1h) or seconds (15). Default: about 120 points over the range. (end - start) / step + 1 may not exceed the connection's points per series.

limit.description: Most series to return; the connection and the endpoint cap it.
